# What can be retrieved, and under which filters

Every search response carries an `applied` block reporting the resolved methods, the
resolved weights and the usetype exclusions that were applied. Read it rather than
inferring from the result count.

## Methods

| method | reads | a document is reachable only with |
|---|---|---|
| `vector` | `documents.embed`, an HNSW index over the 768-dim document vector | a document embedding (`auto_embed`, or the `embed` task) |
| `fulltext` | a PostgreSQL expression GIN index over `title || content` | nothing — the index is an expression over columns every document has |
| `bm25` | the inverted index tables (`search_term_postings`, `search_term_stats`) | a row in a named BM25 index (`auto_index_bm25`, or the `index:bm25` task) |
| `maxsim` | `token_embeddings`, per-token 256-dim vectors, scored by late interaction | token embeddings (`embed_tokens`, or `POST /documents/{id}/tokens`) |

`POST /search/hybrid` fuses several of these with Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Omitting
`methods` runs `vector`, `bm25`. An unrecognised method name is
rejected, not ignored.

## Fusion weights

The default weights are tuned for the default method pair. A fused method with no tuned
weight is multiplied by `1.0`, which is larger than either tuned value — so adding a
method without adding its weight changes the ranking more than the addition itself does.
Pass an explicit `weights` map to control this, or `{}` for equal-weight RRF.

| method | weight in the default fusion |
|---|---|
| `vector` | `0.86` |
| `fulltext` | `1.0` |
| `bm25` | `0.14` |
| `maxsim` | `1.0` |

## Filters

| filter | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `usetype` | unset | keep only this usetype. Supports `*` and `?`. Overrides `exclude_types` entirely. |
| `exclude_types` | `entity`, `entities`, `summary`, `derived` | drop these usetypes. **Applied when the request names none** — this is the filter that shortens a result list with no explanation. Pass `[]` to disable it. |
| `parent_id` | unset | keep only documents in this subtree. |
| `as_of` | unset | keep only documents whose domain clock `COALESCE(event_time, created_at)` is at or before this instant. |
| `threshold` | `0.0` | vector search only: minimum cosine similarity. |
| `limit` | `10` | result ceiling, 1 to 100. |
| settled state | always applied | documents still being ingested are excluded, and this cannot be turned off. |
| subtree access | always applied | a document under an access-control root is returned only to a principal granted read on it. A document under no such root is unprotected. |

## Exclusion has two layers

`exclude_types` is a search-time filter and is reported in `applied.exclude_types`. BM25
also excludes at INDEX time — `entity`, `entities`, `summary`, `derived` are never
written to an inverted index at all — so no search argument brings them back to the bm25
leg. Re-indexing does.
